Lessons.Title: Finding Limits: Properties of Limits
ExplanationParagraphs: Polynomial limits at finite a follow direct substitution.
Limit laws permit sums, products, quotients when denominator limit is nonzero.
A 0/0 quotient needs factoring, common denominator or conjugate rationalization.
Absolute-value quotients may have different one-sided limits.
Factor and cancel only on punctured neighborhood and preserve original domain.
Independent Cool-down: evaluate a representative local example and explain the limiting or derivative reasoning.

CommonMistakes.Mistake: Substitute directly into0/0 or assume a hole changes approached limit.
